expected_configuration_delta.CONFIG_SCHED_HRTICK: y (derived def_bool HIGH_RES_TIMERS; runtime features remain disabled by default)

held_constant: storage software IOS 12 MHz legacy 8-bit; existing parent-clock assumption unchanged
reasoning: The active continuous clocksource and oneshot clock-event driver support the requested timer resolution statically. Enabling HRT can avoid a full 4 ms tick for each 50-100 us sleep; actual scheduled wake latency still depends on runtime activation, load and scheduling.
runtime_requirements: Confirm v20 and CONFIG_HIGH_RES_TIMERS=y on the same board identity.
Confirm the architecture clock-event/clocksource remain active and high-resolution operation is enabled or demonstrate a short timer delay distribution.
Repeat bounded direct-I/O integrity checks with matched size/modes and inspect MMC/PVR errors.
Compare matched per-operation timing and boot/UI observations; do not treat aggregate unequal-size test durations or quantized CPU ticks as precise performance proof.
storage_clock_caveat: SMHC3 mux0 is documented SYS_CLK24M, distinct from the board DCXO26 MHz. The driver uses a24 MHz parent constant; this is supported by source definitions but IOS alone is not a physical calibration. A later HS candidate must verify the PLL source/selection and divisors from saved readback. The HRT clocksource observation is independent: ARM physical arch_timer reports24 MHz.
